experiment_focus: garment surface patterns, layered trim and textile/accessory relations; coordinator-owned creative focus
reference_scope: Visible face guidance only for a fictional adult subject. No actual identity, age, body, personality, health or history claim.

required_components: graphite-and-ivory small repeated jagged broken-check forms
pattern stays on the visible woven jacket surface
keyword_tests.required_relation: The broken checks occupy the same cropped jacket panels worn by the subject.
keyword_tests.prompt_evidence: a cropped graphite-and-ivory houndstooth jacket, its woven surface covered in small jagged broken checks

keyword_tests.required_relation: The ruffle belongs to the blouse above the jacket neckline and is separate from the scarf.
keyword_tests.prompt_evidence: a softly gathered ruffled collar standing around her neck

required_components: separate lower tier below raised ruffle
keyword_tests.required_relation: The lace tier fans outward over the jacket neckline beneath the raised ruffle on the same blouse.
keyword_tests.prompt_evidence: a separate lower tier of scalloped lace fanning outward over the jacket neckline. The lace has small openwork holes and distinct rounded scallops along its outer edge

keyword_tests.required_relation: The stripes stay on the scarf cloth including its exposed tails; they do not transfer to hair or collar.
keyword_tests.prompt_evidence: A narrow striped silk neck scarf

keyword_tests.keyword: side neck knot and two scarf tails
required_components: knot sits below the raised ruffle
keyword_tests.required_relation: Both tails continue from the same knotted scarf and lie over one jacket lapel while the ruffle and lace remain assessable.
confusion_boundary: separate decorative strips without scarf connection
knot covering all lower lace evidence
keyword_tests.prompt_evidence: sits beneath the raised ruffle and is tied in a small knot to one side; two short striped tails lie over that jacket lapel, leaving the layered collar readable

keyword_tests.keyword: separate blouse and open jacket edges
required_components: distinct raised ruffle and lower lace boundaries
keyword_tests.required_relation: The jacket overlays the blouse while the blouse collar trim is exposed outside the jacket neckline.
confusion_boundary: scarf is the only visible second layer

required_components: compact hair mass ending near chin or jaw
keyword_tests.required_relation: The endpoints belong to the subject hair, with no retained long rear hair contradicting the compact bob.
confusion_boundary: short front locks with long rear length
lower hair edge hidden by crop
keyword_tests.prompt_evidence: A dark chin-length bob with wispy strands frames her face

keyword_tests.keyword: held book at anatomical right hip
required_components: thumb on front cover and fingers behind supporting book
keyword_tests.required_relation: The hand connects continuously to the right arm and supports the same book at the adjacent right hip.
keyword_tests.prompt_evidence: her right hand holding a slim paper-wrapped book upright against her right hip, thumb resting on its front cover and fingers supporting its back

required_components: upper thighs included enough to read hip book relation
keyword_tests.required_relation: The frame preserves the neck layers, both hand mechanisms and adjacent hip in one saved original image.
keyword_tests.prompt_evidence: a vertical head-to-upper-thigh frame, including both hands and the jacket hem

required_components: cool window light and warm kiosk light
keyword_tests.required_relation: The subject occupies one believable station book kiosk.
keyword_tests.prompt_evidence: inside a used-book kiosk in an old railway concourse at dawn

keyword_tests.required_relation: The gentle camera acknowledgment belongs to the same subject with reference-guided facial proportions.
